model_decision: No enrichment signal was adopted; model stays radar-3. See README + method panel for the validation table.

sources.dev_activity: Electric Capital open-dev-data taxonomy exported at 2026-11-14 (7,072,900 lines, 7,665 ecosystems; MIT code / CC BY 4.0 data, attribution: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital, CC BY 4.0). Exact repo match for only 6/104 comps, so no commit-count term was fitted; github orgs come from DefiLlama /protocol/{slug}.
sources.fees_tvl_raises: DefiLlama free API (api.llama.fi): GET /overview/fees (coverage), GET /summary/fees/{slug} (daily fees chart), GET /protocol/{slug} (daily TVL, raises, github). No key. Fees are daily FEES (totalDataChart); no daily revenue series is exposed, so annualized fees are used, not revenue.
sources.launch_watch: GeckoTerminal keyless /networks/{eth,base,solana}/new_pools (2026-11-18T08:30Z), filtered to pools created within 48h with FDV >= $100K.
sources.token_born: DexScreener official API /latest/dex/search (2026-11-18) for all 40 watchlist names; GeckoTerminal keyless /search/pools (2026-11-18) for the 11 name-match candidates.

tvl_sanity: Reconstructed TVL at 2026-11-14 vs snapshot tvl_usd for 104 comps: median abs diff 0.31%, mean 1.22%; worst stusdt 80.0% (pit $9,491,269 vs snapshot $47,373,718). Median <= 2% passes the design gate.
